transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brought me in is that... some nights after I get off work at the store, or maybe after a tense dinner, I start eating and it's like the decision-making part of me just shuts off. I can literally see myself reaching for more food, but I just can’t make myself stop.
After these episodes happen, do you do anything to try to make up for the food you've eaten, such as making yourself throw up, using laxatives, or exercising intensely?

Yeah, I do. Um... there have been times, usually after everyone goes to bed, where I'll go into the bathroom and make myself throw up. Or sometimes I'll take laxatives. I just tell myself that I need to do it to... to undo the damage from all that food. But honestly, right after I do it, I just feel really embarrassed. And physically, I get kind of shaky.
Could you tell me your current height and weight?
I'm 5 foot 10. As for my weight, um... I'm actually not entirely sure right now. I haven't stepped on a scale in a little while, so I don't have an exact number for you today.
Even if it's not an exact number, about how much did you weigh the last time you checked?

Um, honestly, I really don't remember. It's been a long time since I actually looked. I kind of just... avoid the scale because it stresses me out too much. So I really couldn't even give you a good estimate right now.
Has a doctor or healthcare provider recently expressed concern that you are significantly underweight?
No, no one's brought that up. I haven't had any doctors or anyone mention being concerned about me being underweight.
On average, how often would you say these episodes of overeating followed by purging or using laxatives happen in a typical week?

For the last few months, I'd say it's been happening most weeks. Usually, it's about once a week that I'll have one of those... out-of-control eating nights. And then I try to make up for it afterward. I'll either throw up, take some laxatives, skip meals the next day, or force myself to go on a really long walk. So yeah, on average, I'd say about once a week.
How much does your weight or body shape influence how you feel about yourself as a person?

It honestly affects me a lot. Like, when I'm at work and my cashier shirt pulls a little at my stomach, I spend the whole shift feeling like customers can tell I have no discipline. It just ruins my day. My mood and how I feel about myself as a person really just depends way too much on how I look that day.
